about: BLAST YOUR WAY THROUGH AN INTERDIMENSIONAL ADVENTURE
Ratchet and Clank are back! Help them stop a robotic emperor intent on conquering cross-dimensional worlds, with their own universe next in the firing line.
Witness the evolution of the dream team as they’re joined by Rivet – a Lombax resistance fighter from another dimension.
- Blast your way home with an arsenal of outrageous weaponry.
- Experience the shuffle of dimensional rifts and dynamic gameplay.
- Explore never-before-seen planets and alternate dimension versions of old favorites.
summary: BLAST YOUR WAY THROUGH AN INTERDIMENSIONAL ADVENTURE
